description: After separating row-killing automorphism directions, a six-dimensional exact rank-six cone remains; every point integrates through cubic order, while a universal quartic cokernel functional blocks the entire transversal.

independent_review.scope: No independent review is represented in this public record.

manuscript_coverage.coverage_rule: Complete coverage requires an exact LaTeX location for every program-relevant defining claim. A locator records where the current statement and evidence boundary appear; it is not a proof-review status.

members.statement: At the specified rank-six compression point, quadratic source fields contain a 109-dimensional row-killing affine family with constant quartic obstruction, including a 75-dimensional family of triangular polynomial automorphisms; the remaining tangent quotient has dimension 20 and is generically second-order obstructed.
members.title: The 19-to-18 Compression Problem Has 109 Row-Killing Directions

members.statement: In the displayed six-dimensional transversal, the exact rank-six cone is the reduced union V(u3,u5) union V(u0,u3) union V(u2,u5); every point integrates to an exact cubic rank-six jet, but the universal quartic cokernel functional Gamma_4 is identically -1, so no member lifts through quartic order.
members.title: The Complete Six-Dimensional Compression Transversal Does Not Lift

source_treatment: No claim is made that one of the six working manuscripts is the source for this page.
